comparison.objective: Hang mugs on a mug tree; candidate tunes and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Handle-to-peg alignment, hooking, and release versus recessed tool engagement, bimanual fine rotation, tightening, and guarded control actuation.
comparison.success_condition: Mugs must remain hanging; candidate requires repeatable energy absorption without forbidden impacts and a retained setting. Setup and scoring fields are missing.
comparison.reason: Hook placement tests support engagement, not precision commissioning of a dynamic mechanism.
